actorSortUnit.rule: body, dress, weapon and helmet must enter actor_y_sort as one composite CanvasItem

invariants: Internal layer z_index values are resolved inside the composite boundary.
No equipment child contributes an independent world z_index against wall fronts.
No equipment child is top_level or uses z_as_relative=false.
A wall-front actor_y_sort unit in front of the actor feet occludes body, dress, weapon and helmet together.
A wall-front actor_y_sort unit behind the actor feet leaves the complete actor visible.
